target_name: Ranked Internal Knowledge Cover Per Claim
rationale: This is a strictly monotone re-transform of the already-evaluated "Internal Knowledge Cover Per Liability Dollar" (identical quantile sorts, by the proposer's own admission), so it is a cosmetic variant that can only move the FMB slope and adds no new economic content.

target_name: Liquid And Knowledge Buffer Per Claim
rationale: Adding cash to the non-goodwill resource base is a coherent and internally consistent economic modification of the cover-ratio family rather than a transform, though the added leg overlaps materially with the well-documented cash-holdings/liquidity return premium and the increment over the parent signal is modest.

target_name: Knowledge Share Of Total Economic Burden
rationale: The expression is monotone in R&D-stock/(liabilities + cumulative burn), i.e. a bounded rescaling of the knowledge-cover ratios already tested in the archive, so the "composition" framing is a distributional reparameterization rather than a new mechanism.

target_name: Pre Research Cash Flow Cover Of Claims
rationale: The hypothesis (R&D as discretionary rather than committed) genuinely reverses the archive's post-research convention and the expression matches it, but the base term oancf/lt is essentially Ohlson's funds-from-operations-to-total-liabilities distress component, so much of any result will be a rediscovery of known distress/profitability pricing with an R&D add-back wrinkle.

target_name: Durable Research Floor Versus Rollover Need
rationale: With COALESCE(xrd,0) the five-year minimum is zero for the large majority of firm-years and is an order of magnitude smaller than dlc even for research firms, so the signal collapses to negative short-term-debt-to-assets — a known leverage/distress measure — and the claimed full coverage is a symptom of that degeneracy rather than a virtue.

target_name: Ranked Burn Adjusted Real Intangible Cover
rationale: Denominator and most of the numerator are identical to the already-evaluated "Knowledge Solvency Net Of Burn Per Claim," so once the rank transform is recognized as monotone the only genuine change is subtracting goodwill, making this an incremental variant dressed up as a consolidation test.
